D004-D017_h001.question:
It’s hard to put into words without sounding crazy, but it’s been going on maybe a few months now, on and off. I do a lot of surveillance at night, stakeouts, that kind of thing, and lately I can’t shake this feeling that something terrible is about to happen, like everything is winding down. I’ll be sitting in my car watching a building and it feels like it’s all about to collapse, or like none of this is actually going to be here much longer.

At the same time I’ve gotten really fixated on how I look. I catch my reflection in a shop window between jobs and I’m convinced there’s something off—my face looks distorted, like my jaw’s caved in a bit or my skin’s…wrong somehow. Photos make it worse; I can barely stand to look at them because I’m sure I see some defect other people either don’t notice or won’t admit to. I ask my ex or a client in a roundabout way if I look different, and they brush it off, but it doesn’t really convince me.
